message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts.

First, multiple thefts (盗窃) – multiple instances of burglary (入室盗窃). The behavior: "踹门入室实施盗窃" etc. So crime: 盗窃罪 (theft). Possibly also "入室盗窃" is a specific form, but still theft.

Second, false accusation causing others to be detained: He fabricated involvement of others, causing them to be criminally detained. That is "诬告陷害罪" (defamation? Actually "诬告陷害罪" is false accusation leading to criminal investigation). The rule: fabricating facts to cause others to be detained. So crime: 诬告陷害罪.

Thus two crimes: 盗窃罪; 诬告陷害罪.

Check if any other crimes: He also stole identity documents, but still theft. No violent assault. So answer: 盗窃; 诬告陷害.

Need format: [罪名]盗窃;诬告陷害<eoa>

Make sure spacing? In examples they separate with semicolon and no spaces. Use same.
